about_short_description.short_description: Continue is a communication agency that develops, revise and maintains corporate appearances as well as design marketing strategy.

product.name: Corporate Design
product.description: Development and revision of visual corporate identity elements such as logos, business stationery, and branding materials.

product.name: Editorial Design
product.description: Design and layout of printed and digital publications such as magazines, newsletters, and brochures.

product.name: Corporate Publishing
product.description: Creation and management of corporate communication materials like annual reports, magazines, and informational brochures.

product.name: Communication Strategy and Consulting
product.description: Development of communication strategies and concepts to support corporate branding and marketing goals.

product.name: Graphic Design
product.description: Creation of visual content including illustrations, pictograms, posters, flyers, and promotional materials.

product.name: Key Visual Development
product.description: Design of central visual elements that represent and unify a project or campaign’s identity.
